This is the marketplace.json for the shared 'platform' plugin: cross-cutting atomics (create-api-token, generate-kubeconfig, verify-in-grafana, ...) that don't belong to a single product line. Concrete `skills` entries are populated by the build script from dist/<name>/SKILL.md — do not hand-edit the list. The `name`, `version`, `description`, and `owner` fields are authored.
name: coreweave-platform-skills
description: Cross-cutting CoreWeave Cloud platform skills: API tokens, kubeconfig, Grafana verification, IAM. Foundation skills used by every product-line plugin.
